Some of my writing comes in runs: a project, a course or a book I worked through over weeks or months. Each series below is listed in reading order.

{{< series-index >}}

```{=html}
<script>
document.querySelectorAll(".series-filters button").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const f = btn.dataset.filter;
  document.querySelectorAll(".series-filters button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b === btn));
  document.querySelectorAll(".series-entry").forEach(s => { s.hidden = f !== "all" && s.dataset.section !== f; });
}));
</script>
```
